title: Saul Preaches in Damascus and Flees
description: Saul boldly proclaims that Jesus is the Son of God in the synagogues of Damascus, proving that he is the Messiah. When the Jews plot to kill him, his disciples lower him through the wall in a basket at night. In Jerusalem, the believers are afraid of him, but Barnabas brings him to the apostles. When the Greeks also seek to kill him, the brothers send him to Tarsus via Caesarea.
